svg.title: caddy-ui-vector-studies
svg.desc: Overview of three wordmarks and seven favicon studies. All artwork and labels are vector outlines.

svg.title: 02-cursor-finish
svg.desc: Light IBM Plex Mono lettering and separate block cursor. Transparent background. Clean vector reconstruction of the design study.

svg.title: 06-weight-shift
svg.desc: IBM Plex Mono Light caddy and Bold /ui. Transparent background. Each outlined glyph can be edited independently.

svg.title: 07-bracket-baseline
svg.desc: Custom geometric lowercase lettering with separate lower corner marks. All artwork consists of editable paths. This is not a stock font.

svg.title: 2a-c-plus-cursor
svg.desc: Editable favicon study. Background, lettering and cursor are separate objects. 64-unit SVG viewBox; inspect at actual 16 and 32 px before production use.
